ValidationRule.description: Does not allow a case status to move backwards once it moves to In Progress.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name = "NAS General Support Case", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "In Progress"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "On Hold - Customer"), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), "On Hold - Internal")), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, "New"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Assigned"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Validate") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Case Status cannot go backwards from In Progress.
